rows.note: Use 濕晒 as the everyday all-purpose way to say that someone or something is drenched or wet through.

example.english: My shirt is soaked—you can wring water out of it.
example.jyutping: gin6 saam1 sap1 saai3 ning6 dak1 ceot1 seoi2 aa3

rows.note: Use 醉晒 when describing a person who is very drunk, not physically soaked with liquid.

example.english: They were completely soaked after drinking all night and could not even remember where home was.
example.traditional: 佢飲到醉晒，連屋企喺邊都唔記得。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jam2 dou3 zeoi3 saai3 lin4 uk1 kei2 hai2 bin1 dou1 m4 gei3 dak1
